description: Read-only. Looks up the customer's own IMPOSSIBREW orders and subscription: order status, tracking, delivery dates, subscription details, next delivery and store credit. This tool cannot change, cancel or refund anything. The message goes to the AI Brewer, the same assistant as on impossibrew.co.uk, which checks identity (email plus delivery postcode, or an order number starting EC plus either). message is the customer's own words. The first call has no conversationId; each result returns the conversationId that continues the same conversation across these order tools. The reply is the AI Brewer's complete answer.
name: check_order
title: Check my order
